WHAT: Load more button appends Vinted results page by page without re-running the full cascade
WHERE: lib/vinted-search.ts (cascade returns winningParams), app/api/search/route.ts (accepts page param), components/SearchResults.tsx (Load more button)
HOW: When cascade finds results, it returns the winning search params alongside listings. Client stores these as winningParams state. Load more calls the same API with winningParams + page:2,3,4. Results appended to existing grid.
WHY: Cascade is expensive (6 strategies, API calls per try). Re-running it for page 2 would be slow and might pick a different strategy, breaking pagination continuity.
GOTCHA: Load more button disappears when a page returns fewer than 20 results (end of results). Button shows spinner while loading.
